news.title: Maduro and wife seek to end drug charges case on immunity grounds
news.summary: Former Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro and his wife have asked a judge to dismiss the drug trafficking indictment against them on the grounds that they have immunity as the leader and first lady of a foreign country
